answer_1.quote: Image captioning is a fundamental task to examine whether an intelligent system can understand the visual world by letting the system describe it with natural language.

answer_2.quote: This generation task adopts the traditional image captioning evaluation metric using the open-source tool with a minor modification to suit with LN-COCO, including BLEU , METEOR , ROUGE-L , ROUGE-1-F1(Pont-Tuset et al., 2020), and CIDEr-D.
